title: Classic Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish made with chicken, aromatic spices, and sweet ingredients, slow-cooked in a clay pot.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the algerian spice blend, kissed preserved lemon, and dried apricots.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the honey, if using.
Serve the chicken and sauce over couscous or rice.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
